Unit 4, Example Trading Estate

scope: Storm damage repair to the rear pitched roof. Erect scaffold to the rear elevation, strip and replace slipped and broken concrete tiles (approx. 4 m²), renew the lead flashing at the chimney abutment, re-bed and point the ridge, and clear the gutters on completion. All waste removed from site.

items.description: Scaffold to rear elevation (erect, 2 weeks hire, dismantle)
Concrete interlocking tiles to match existing
Ridge re-bed and point (per linear metre)
Roofing labour: strip, re-tile and flash (2 roofers, per day)

notes: Fully insured. Any further damage found once the roof is opened will be photographed and agreed with you before work continues. Payment due on completion.
